_about: The home page's gallery (public_site.showcase) and its reel of video ads (public_site.showreel). items: only real Campaignify outputs, no stock photos, no other companies' ads, no mock-ups. videos: our own generated footage only, and each one says where it came from: source "campaignify" (it came out of a Campaignify preset) or "team" (our team made it with AI video outside the app). No stock, no other companies' ads, no real people. Put each file in this folder and add one entry.

_shape.preset: the preset id that made it, e.g. hero, clean-headline, offer, marketplace, ugc, voiceover, product_video
_shape.caption: one short line shown under the tile
_shape.alt: what the picture or clip shows, for screen readers
_shape.poster: videos only: a still in this folder, shown before the clip loads

_video_shape.file: clip.mp4 in this folder (H.264, 720x1280 or smaller, under 3 MB)
_video_shape.poster: a still in this folder, shown before the clip loads (required)
_video_shape.preset: source campaignify only: the preset id that made it (its name is the title)
_video_shape.title: source team: a short name for the kind of ad
_video_shape.caption: one short line under the title: who it was made for, or that the brand is made up
_video_shape.alt: what the clip shows, for screen readers
_video_shape.presenter: true when a person is on screen: the tile is labelled AI presenter
_video_shape.sound: true when the clip has speech: the tile gets a Sound button

_sizes: Images: JPEG or WebP, 1080 px on the short side (1080x1350 for 4:5, 1080x1920 for 9:16, 1080x1080 for 1:1), under 400 KB. Videos: MP4 (H.264, no audio needed), 720x1280, 5 to 10 seconds, under 3 MB, each with a poster. 8 to 12 items in a mix of shapes fills the grid best; at most 12 are shown.
